instructions: Only flag critical bugs, security issues, and architectural concerns; skip style nitpicks and minor improvements unless they materially affect correctness or maintainability. In *_test.go, web/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, and agent/**/*.test.ts, review correctness and coverage only and flag vacuous assertions - a test that asserts a zero value or the mere absence of an error still passes when the behavior regresses. In api/internal/handler/**, flag any new API route the uzi CLI consumes that is mounted in the cookie-only RequireAuth group instead of RequireUser (which accepts a session cookie OR a uzc_ Bearer); verify forge PATs and per-user Anthropic tokens are never logged or returned unredacted, and that settings/config reads fail closed. In web/src/mocks/**, do not flag production-fidelity gaps - it is demo/dev scaffolding. In deploy/**, focus on correctness of Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and Kustomize config. In prds/**, docs/**, and ideas/**, review only for clarity, scope, and duplication; do not flag unbuilt mechanisms.
